nodes.characterization_summary: Low-magnification TEM analysis of Ru_{fcc/hcp} aerogels shows no noticeable alteration in nanoparticle size distribution despite varying RuCl₃ concentrations.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Low-magnification transmission electron microscopy (TEM) analysis revealed that despite significant variations in the Ru precursor concentration, the size distribution of Ru nanoparticles constituting the aerogel showed no noticeable alteration (Figure S2).

nodes.characterization_summary: ICP-OES confirms Cr:Ru atomic ratios of 0.008:0.992, 0.022:0.978, 0.033:0.967, and 0.041:0.959 for the Cr_x Ru_{1-x fcc/hcp} aerogel series.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In Table S1, ICP-OES results showed that the atomic ratios between Cr and Ru in the series of Cr_x Ru_{1 - x fcc / hcp} aerogels were 0.008: 0.992, 0.022: 0.978, 0.033: 0.967, and 0.041: 0.959, respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: BET physisorption shows Cr_{0.033}Ru_{0.967 fcc / hcp} aerogel has specific surface area of 66 m² g⁻¹ with mesoporous pore sizes (2-50 nm).
nodes.evidence_snippet: In Figure S4, the Cr_{0.033}Ru_{0.967 fcc / hcp} aerogel exhibits a high specific surface area of 66 m² g⁻¹, with pore sizes primarily distributed in the mesoporous range (2 - 50 nm).

nodes.characterization_summary: XRD patterns show mixed fcc/hcp phases in Ru aerogels with peaks at 38.3° and 44.0° for hcp Ru (100) and (101) shifting to broad peak at 42° for fcc (111); Cr doping does not significantly alter peaks.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure 1b displays the XRD patterns of Ru aerogels synthesized at room temperature with varying RuCl₃ concentrations of 0.48, 0.60, 0.80, 1.20, and 2.40 mM. At the lowest concentration (0.48 mM), two diffraction peaks were observed at 38.3° and 44.0° ... Cr ion doping did not significantly alter the XRD peaks and phase ratio.

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM confirms mixed fcc/hcp Ru structure with lattice spacing of 2.2 Å corresponding to hcp (002) and fcc (111) planes.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Figure 1c displays the atomic arrangement of a suitably oriented nanoparticle. ... the measured lattice spacing of 2.2 Å corresponds to the (002) plane of hcp Ru and the (111) plane of fcc Ru, respectively.

nodes.characterization_summary: EDX confirms presence of Ru and detectable Cr in CrRu_{fcc / hcp} aerogel.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In Figure S7a-d, Energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDXs) and scanning transmission electron microscopy- electron energy loss spectroscopy (STEM-EELS) analysis confirm the presence of Ru alongside detectable Cr in the CrRu_{fcc / hcp} aerogel.

nodes.characterization_summary: High-resolution XPS Ru 3p shows metallic Ru peaks at 461.7 eV (3p_{3/2}) and 483.8 eV (3p_{1/2}), oxidized Ru at 465.8 and 487.8 eV; binding energy shifts confirm electronic structure optimization by phase regulation and Cr doping; Cr 2p peak at 576.3 eV.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in Figure 1i, high-resolution XPS spectra of the Ru 3p region revealed spin-orbit-split doublets, with peaks at 461.7 and 483.8 eV corresponding to Ru 3p_{3/2} and Ru 3p_{1/2} of metallic Ru ... the Cr 2p spectra exhibited a weak peak at 576.3 eV.

nodes.characterization_summary: STEM-EELS confirms presence of Ru and Cr in CrRu_{fcc/hcp} aerogel with O-K edge at 532 eV indicating partial oxidation of metallic Ru.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In Figure S7a-d, Energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDXs) and scanning transmission electron microscopy- electron energy loss spectroscopy (STEM-EELS) analysis confirm the presence of Ru alongside detectable Cr in the CrRu_{fcc / hcp} aerogel ... peaks at around 532 eV corresponding to O-K edge were also observed.

nodes.characterization_summary: Zeta potential analysis shows notable shift for mixed-phase Ru_{fcc/hcp} aerogels compared to hcp and fcc Ru aerogels, further amplified by Cr incorporation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As illustrated in Figure S8, the zeta potential values of mixed-phase Ru aerogels exhibit a notable shift compared to those of hcp and fcc Ru aerogels. Moreover, the incorporation of Cr ions further amplifies this shift.

nodes.characterization_summary: UPS shows work functions of Ru_{hcp} (4.5 eV), Ru_{fcc/hcp} (4.45 eV), and CrRu_{fcc/hcp} (4.4 eV).
nodes.evidence_snippet: In Figure S9, UPS results indicate a minor decrease in the work functions among the Ru_{hcp} (4.5 eV), Ru_{fcc / hcp} (4.45 eV), and CrRu_{fcc / hcp} (4.4 eV).
